pull_request.body:
This PR does not change runtime behavior.

It extracts the implicit delegation boundary already present after Agent Session work into an explicit architectural contract.

Goals:
- separate CAP-owned trust semantics from provider mechanics;
- define Provider Result vs Verified Effect boundary;
- prepare future provider compatibility checks without adding a new runtime.

No scheduler, multi-agent runtime, or provider-specific expansion is introduced.
